g.text: What runs where, and how the parts talk. One operator scaffolds, runs the agents and merges; Kubernetes, Gitea, Agent Sandbox and Claude Code do the heavy lifting.
One node, 12 cores. Images are built locally and loaded, never pushed.

and Claude Code on a toolchain image (agent-base, agent-go), with
its workspace in memory and no ServiceAccount token. Its result
leaves as JSON in the termination message.
